purpose: Continue raw accumulation through 67579, 95776, 79056 and 07659 while broadening Worldshepherd utility routing beyond physics to security, civil materials, finance, environmental technology, imaging, isotope separation and data/modeling methods.

policy.rule: Raw exact-number occurrences are retained for collision statistics with zero automatic physical-evidence weight regardless of how useful the underlying source may be to Worldshepherd.
policy.promotion: Utility and Glob evidence are independent axes; P1/P2 requires verified physical semantics and provenance, while M1/N0 records may still carry high engineering, software, security, commercial or operational utility.
policy.namespace_control: CVE, DOI/article, PMID, postal, patent and repository identifiers are classified by namespace before independence or significance is assessed.

information_updates.finding: The cement-paste dataset provides a current open benchmark for ultrasonic pulse-transmission monitoring of hydration and material-property evolution, useful for nondestructive testing and solver validation.
The wind-finance study provides a non-physics utility example: financing and subsidy mechanism selection can feed commercialization/capital-model scenarios for energy projects.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 07659 is DOI metadata and carries zero Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: CVE-2025-67579 is a direct security-hardening input despite contributing no physical evidence, demonstrating the domain-agnostic usefulness rule in operation.

The 95776 postal-code cluster surfaces useful environmental and instrumentation work including resonant sonic drilling, micro-CT cold-stage design, landfill-gas capture measurement and biomass gasifier simulation.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 95776 is an address/funding identifier, not a physical parameter.
